31K likes, 262 comments - filmfare on September 30, 2026: "She never played by the rules. She made her own.🔥

Meet our cover star, #TaapseePannu.✨

In an exclusive conversation with Filmfare, Taapsee opens up about Gandhari, taking risks, building a career on her own terms, turning producer, marriage and the lessons she has learnt along the way.

Read the full cover story on Filmfare.com
